title: Digital Wallet Safety Comic Strip
problem: Village elders think phone payment apps automatically steal money from accounts, so they avoid using safe digital payments entirely.
idea: A friendly comic that shows Tata how phone payments work and the few rules that keep money safe. Then a small quiz to check what he learned.

items.title: Panel 1
items.text: Tata: 'Phone apps take money by themselves!' Grandson Ravi: 'No Tata, money moves only when YOU enter your secret PIN.'
items.te: తాత: 'ఫోన్ యాప్ తానే డబ్బు తీసేస్తుంది!' రవి: 'లేదు తాతా, మీరు పిన్ వేస్తేనే డబ్బు వెళ్తుంది.'

items.title: Panel 2
items.text: Ravi shows: scan the shop's QR, check the shop name, type the amount, enter PIN. Done!
items.te: రవి: షాప్ క్యూఆర్ స్కాన్ చేసి, పేరు చూసి, మొత్తం టైప్ చేసి, పిన్ వేయండి. అయిపోయింది!

items.title: Panel 3
items.text: A fake call: 'Tell me your OTP!' Tata smiles: 'Banks never ask OTP. Bye!'
items.te: నకిలీ కాల్: 'ఓటీపీ చెప్పండి!' తాత: 'బ్యాంకులు ఓటీపీ అడగవు. బై!'

items.title: Panel 4
items.text: Tata gets money from his son. He just checks the SMS. No scanning, no PIN needed to receive.
items.te: కొడుకు డబ్బు పంపాడు. తాత ఎస్ఎంఎస్ చూశాడు. తీసుకోవడానికి పిన్ అవసరం లేదు.

items.title: Panel 5
items.text: Tata: 'Digital payment is safe when I keep my PIN secret!' Everyone cheers.
items.te: తాత: 'పిన్ రహస్యంగా ఉంచితే డిజిటల్ చెల్లింపు సురక్షితం!'

questions.q: Can a payment app take money without your PIN?
options: No, a payment needs your PIN
questions.why: UPI payments need your secret PIN. Keep it secret.

questions.q: Before paying a shop by QR, what should you check?
options: The shop name shown on the screen
questions.why: Check the name to make sure money goes to the right person.

questions.q: You want to receive money from your son. Do you enter your PIN?
questions.why: PIN is only for sending money.

questions.q: Someone asks your OTP on the phone. You…
questions.why: Banks never ask for OTP. If cheated, call 1930.

items.title: Secret PIN
items.text: Never share UPI PIN or OTP.

items.title: Check the name
items.text: Look at the receiver's name before paying.

items.title: No unknown apps
items.text: Don't install apps a stranger tells you to.

how: Ask Gemini to write a 5-panel comic script about a grandfather learning UPI safety.
Ask it to keep each line short and give a Telugu version.
Open Canva and search for 'comic strip' templates.
Add simple characters, speech bubbles and the lines from Gemini.
Show the comic to Tata and Dadi and ask if they understood.
Print it and stick it at the village kirana shop and library.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student. Write a 5-panel comic strip script in simple English and Telugu where a grandson teaches his grandfather how UPI payments work and why they are safe if he keeps his PIN and OTP secret. Include: PIN is only to pay, check the receiver's name, never share OTP, call 1930 if cheated.
